test-set.name: saxon-schema
test-set.description: Tests for the saxon:schema extension function introduced in Saxon 9.5

source.description: A Schema validated xml file, that contains values for data types. Can be used by any test.

schema.description: A Schema with enumerations, including enumerations on lists
A Schema with fixed and default value constraints

test-case.name: s-schema-001
test-case.description: Use saxon:schema() to list the declarations of various kinds

test-case.name: s-schema-002
test-case.description: Use saxon:schema() to get the properties of an element declaration
test-case.test: let $e := saxon:schema()('element declarations')[1] return <e name="{$e('name')}" namespace="{$e('target namespace')}" nillable="{$e('nillable')}" abstract="{$e('abstract')}" subs="{$e('substitution group affiliations')}" variety="{$e('scope')('variety')}"/>

test-case.name: s-schema-003
test-case.description: Use saxon:schema() to get the properties of a named element declaration
test-case.test: let $e := saxon:schema('element declaration', QName("http://www.w3.org/XQueryTest", "root")) return <e name="{$e('name')}" namespace="{$e('target namespace')}" nillable="{$e('nillable')}" abstract="{$e('abstract')}" subs="{$e('substitution group affiliations')}" variety="{$e('scope')('variety')}"/>

test-case.name: s-schema-004
test-case.description: Use saxon:schema() to get a named type definition
test-case.test: let $e := saxon:schema('type definition', QName("http://www.w3.org/XQueryTest", "rootType")) return <e class="{$e('class')}" name="{$e('name')}" namespace="{$e('target namespace')}" base="{$e('base type definition')('name')}" abstract="{$e('abstract')}" final="{$e('final')}" variety="{$e('content type')('variety')}"/>

result.assert-xml: <e abstract="false" final="" name="rootType" base="anyType" class="Complex Type Definition" variety="element-only" namespace="http://www.w3.org/XQueryTest"/>

test-case.name: s-schema-005
test-case.description: Use saxon:schema() to get a named attribute declaration
test-case.test: let $e := saxon:schema('attribute declaration', QName("http://www.w3.org/XQueryTest", "attr")) return <e class="{$e('class')}" name="{$e('name')}" namespace="{$e('target namespace')}" base="{$e('type definition')('name')}" baseNS="{$e('type definition')('target namespace')}" inheritable="{$e('inheritable')}" variety="{$e('scope')('variety')}"/>

result.assert-xml: <e baseNS="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" name="attr" base="NCName" class="Attribute Declaration" inheritable="false" variety="global" namespace="http://www.w3.org/XQueryTest"/>

test-case.name: s-schema-006
test-case.description: Use saxon:schema() to get a built-in type definition
test-case.test: let $e := saxon:schema('type definition', QName("http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema", "anyURI")) return <e class="{$e('class')}" name="{$e('name')}" namespace="{$e('target namespace')}" base="{$e('base type definition')('name')}" abstract="{$e('abstract')}" final="{$e('final')}" variety="{$e('variety')}"/>

result.assert-xml: <e abstract="" final="" name="anyURI" base="anyAtomicType" class="Simple Type Definition" variety="atomic" namespace="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"/>

test-case.name: s-schema-007
test-case.description: Use saxon:schema() to get a non-existent type definition

test-case.name: s-schema-008
test-case.description: Use saxon:schema() to get the values of a string-valued enumeration type

test-case.name: s-schema-009
test-case.description: Use saxon:schema() to get the values of an int-valued enumeration type

test-case.name: s-schema-010
test-case.description: Use saxon:schema() to get the values of a list-of-string-valued enumeration type

test-case.name: s-schema-011
test-case.description: Use saxon:schema() to get the values of a list-of-integer-valued enumeration type

modified.change: order of results is unpredictable: change assertions

test-case.name: s-schema-012
test-case.description: Use saxon:schema() to get the values of value constraints for element declarations

test-case.name: s-schema-013
test-case.description: Use saxon:schema() to get the values of value constraints for attribute declarations
test-case.test: let $a1 := saxon:schema('attribute declaration', QName("http://saxonica.com/ns/fixedAndDefaultTest", "a1"))("value constraint"), $a2 := saxon:schema('attribute declaration', QName("http://saxonica.com/ns/fixedAndDefaultTest", "a2"))("value constraint"), $b2 := saxon:schema('attribute declaration', QName("http://saxonica.com/ns/fixedAndDefaultTest", "b2"))("value constraint") return map{ "a1":$a1, "a2variety":$a2("variety"), "a2value":$a2("value"), "a2lexical":$a2("lexical form"), "b2variety":$b2("variety"), "b2value":$b2("value"), "b2lexical":$b2("lexical form")}

test-case.name: s-schema-014
test-case.description: Use saxon:schema() to get the values of value constraints for attribute uses
test-case.test: let $e3t := saxon:schema('element declaration', QName("http://saxonica.com/ns/fixedAndDefaultTest", "e3"))("type definition"), $ag := $e3t("attribute uses"), $a2 := $ag[1]("value constraint"), $b2 := $ag[2]("value constraint") return map{ "a2variety":$a2("variety"), "a2value":$a2("value"), "a2lexical":$a2("lexical form"), "b2variety":$b2("variety"), "b2value":$b2("value"), "b2lexical":$b2("lexical form")}
